title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Implemented numerical integration of a porous-medium traveling-wave ODE for u_t+(u^m)_x=(u^m)_{xx} with m=3,c=1 using solve_ivp (RK45) and event stopping at f=1e-8. Generated outputs/solution.csv and mandatory figures report/images/profile.png and report/images/residuals.png. Wrote report/report.md describing model, method/settings, and verification via discrete residual norms and comparison to exact m=3 solution.
